Collections.Name: Ember Blossom
Collections.Description: A flower with petals that glow like hot coals. When ground into a paste, it can cauterize wounds and grant minor fire resistance.

Collections.Name: Fey Ivy
Collections.Description: A silver-leafed vine that shimmers under moonlight. It is used in enchantments to bind magic to objects or to create elusive glamours.

Collections.Name: Grave Dust Lichen
Collections.Description: A brittle, grey lichen found only in ancient graveyards. It is a necessary component for speaking with the dead or creating necrotic poisons.

Collections.Name: Sky-Thread Nettle
Collections.Description: A nettle that grows unnaturally tall, seeking the wind. Its fibers can be woven into potions of levitation or to lighten heavy armor.

Collections.Name: Weeping Widow's Leaf
Collections.Description: A broad leaf that constantly exudes droplets of clear, salty water. It is the base for powerful potions of sorrow and despair.

Collections.Name: Elven Root
Collections.Description: A thick, regenerative root that twitches when cut. It is a potent, if unstable, ingredient for healing salves and regeneration potions.

Collections.Name: Mirage Sage
Collections.Description: A dusty, pale green herb that wavers in the air like a heat haze. Burning its leaves creates confusing hallucinations in a wide area.

Collections.Name: Crystal Dew
Collections.Description: Not an herb itself, but a magical sap collected from the leaves of the Dawnwood tree. Each drop can purify water or be used to identify magical auras.

Collections.Name: Crystal Dew
Collections.Description: A vicious, dark vine covered in hooked thorns. Its essence is used in oils to make weapons inflict painful, bleeding wounds.

Collections.Name: Frost-veil
Collections.Description: A delicate, fern-like herb that feels cold to the touch and is often found near eternal ice. It is used in potions to resist cold and to preserve alchemical ingredients.
